mapper.select: SELECT description AS description,subject AS subject,resource_type AS resourceType,origin_kind AS originKind,published_year AS publishedYear,prepared_year AS preparedYear,author_name AS authorName,publisher_name AS publisherName,acquired_at AS acquiredAt,catalog_status AS catalogStatus,audience_role AS audienceRole,provenance_status AS provenanceStatus FROM kb_source_profilekb_product_profile WHERE source_idproduct_id=#{ownerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_source_profilekb_product_profile(source_idproduct_id,description,subject,resource_type,origin_kind,published_year,prepared_year,author_name,publisher_name,acquired_at,catalog_status,audience_role,provenance_status,create_by,update_by) VALUES(#{ownerId},#{profile.description},#{profile.subject},#{profile.resourceType},#{profile.originKind},#{profile.publishedYear},#{profile.preparedYear},#{profile.authorName},#{profile.publisherName},#{profile.acquiredAt},#{profile.catalogStatus},#{profile.audienceRole},#{profile.provenanceStatus},#{actor},#{actor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description=VALUES(description),subject=VALUES(subject),resource_type=VALUES(resource_type),origin_kind=VALUES(origin_kind),published_year=VALUES(published_year),prepared_year=VALUES(prepared_year),author_name=VALUES(author_name),publisher_name=VALUES(publisher_name),acquired_at=VALUES(acquired_at),catalog_status=VALUES(catalog_status),audience_role=VALUES(audience_role),provenance_status=VALUES(provenance_status),row_version=row_version+1,update_by=VALUES(update_by),update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT s.*,#{ownerKind} AS owner_kind,o.title AS outline_title,o.subject,o.textbook_version,o.grade,o.term,o.status AS outline_status FROM kb_source_outline_scopekb_product_outline_scope s JOIN kb_outline o ON o.id=s.outline_id WHERE s.source_idproduct_id=#{ownerId} ORDER BY s.outline_id
SELECT node_id FROM kb_source_outline_scope_nodekb_product_outline_scope_node WHERE scope_id=#{scopeId} ORDER BY node_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_source_outline_scope_nodekb_product_outline_scope_node WHERE scope_id IN (SELECT id FROM kb_source_outline_scopekb_product_outline_scope WHERE source_idproduct_id=#{ownerId})
mapper.select: SELECT kp_id FROM kb_source_kpkb_product_kp WHERE source_idproduct_id=#{ownerId} ORDER BY kp_id
SELECT DISTINCT qk.kp_id FROM kb_question_kp qk JOIN kb_question_sourcekb_product_question link ON link.question_id=qk.question_id WHERE link.source_idproduct_id=#{ownerId} ORDER BY qk.kp_id

SELECT r.region_role AS role,r.region_code AS regionCode,g.name,CASE WHEN g.region_code IN ('CN','00000000') THEN '全国' ELSE COALESCE(a.full_name,g.name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) END AS fullName FROM kb_source_regionkb_product_region r JOIN kb_region g ON g.region_code=r.region_code LEFT JOIN area_2025 a ON a.code=g.region_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE r.source_idproduct_id=#{ownerId} ORDER BY r.region_role,r.region_code
mapper.sql: r.region_code AS regionCode,r.parent_code AS parentCode,r.name,CASE WHEN r.region_code IN ('CN','00000000') THEN '全国' ELSE COALESCE(a.full_name,r.name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) END AS fullName,r.level,r.status,r.standard_code AS standardCode,r.source_url AS sourceUrl,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_region c WHERE c.parent_code=r.region_code) AS hasChildren
mapper.select: SELECT FROM kb_region r LEFT JOIN area_2025 a ON a.code=r.region_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE r.region_code=#{code}

SELECT FROM kb_region r LEFT JOIN area_2025 a ON a.code=r.region_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
NOT (r.region_code='CN' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_region canonical WHERE canonical.region_code='00000000'))
AND r.parent_code=CASE WHEN #{parentCode}='CN' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_region canonical WHERE canonical.region_code='00000000') THEN '00000000' ELSE #{parentCode} END AND r.parent_code IS NULL
AND (r.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR a.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.region_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY r.level,r.region_code

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (SELECT region_code FROM kb_region WHERE region_code=#{code} UNION ALL SELECT r.region_code FROM kb_region r JOIN descendants d ON r.parent_code=d.region_code) SELECT region_code FROM descendants

SELECT e.exam_type AS examPurpose,e.exam_year AS examYear,e.grade,e.school_name AS schoolName,e.scope_note AS scopeNote,e.authenticity_status AS authenticityStatus,e.verification_note AS verificationNote,d.entrance_stage AS entranceStage,d.organizer_level AS organizerLevel,d.paper_nature AS paperNature,d.exam_date AS examDate,d.academic_year_start AS academicYearStart,d.term,d.session_label AS sessionLabel,d.paper_code AS paperCode,d.organizer_name AS organizerName,d.evidence_asset_id AS evidenceAssetId,d.verified_at AS verifiedAt,d.verified_by AS verifiedBy,d.identity_fingerprint AS identityFingerprint,(d.source_id IS NULL) AS legacyVerification FROM kb_exam_source e LEFT JOIN kb_exam_source_detail d ON d.source_id=e.source_id WHERE e.source_id=#{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_exam_source_detail(source_id,entrance_stage,organizer_level,paper_nature,exam_date,academic_year_start,term,session_label,paper_code,organizer_name,evidence_asset_id,verified_at,verified_by,identity_fingerprint,create_by,update_by) VALUES(#{sourceId},#{exam.entranceStage},#{exam.organizerLevel},#{exam.paperNature},#{exam.examDate},#{exam.academicYearStart},#{exam.term},#{exam.sessionLabel},#{exam.paperCode},#{exam.organizerName},#{exam.evidenceAssetId},#{exam.verifiedAt},#{exam.verifiedBy},#{exam.identityFingerprint},#{actor},#{actor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE entrance_stage=VALUES(entrance_stage),organizer_level=VALUES(organizer_level),paper_nature=VALUES(paper_nature),exam_date=VALUES(exam_date),academic_year_start=VALUES(academic_year_start),term=VALUES(term),session_label=VALUES(session_label),paper_code=VALUES(paper_code),organizer_name=VALUES(organizer_name),evidence_asset_id=VALUES(evidence_asset_id),verified_at=VALUES(verified_at),verified_by=VALUES(verified_by),identity_fingerprint=VALUES(identity_fingerprint),row_version=row_version+1,update_by=VALUES(update_by),update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT p.seq,p.question_id AS questionId,p.question_row_version AS questionRowVersion,p.stem_hash AS stemHash,p.item_locator AS itemLocator,q.title AS questionTitle FROM kb_product_question p JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=p.question_id WHERE product_id=#{productId} ORDER BY seq
SELECT r.source_id AS sourceId,r.note,s.title AS sourceTitle FROM kb_product_reference_source r JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=r.source_id WHERE product_id=#{productId} ORDER BY source_id
SELECT collection_kind AS collectionKind,note,evidence_asset_id AS evidenceAssetId,row_version AS rowVersion FROM kb_occurrence_collection WHERE occurrence_id=#{occurrenceId} ORDER BY collection_kind

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_exam_source_detail WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND evidence_asset_id=#{assetId})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_occurrence_collection c JOIN kb_question_source qs ON qs.id=c.occurrence_id WHERE qs.source_id=#{sourceId} AND c.evidence_asset_id=#{assetId})
